heading.title: Maintenance of Parents and Senior Citizens

article.title: Deposit of maintenance amount.
article.content: When an order is made under this Chapter, the children or relative who is required to pay any amount in terms of such order shall within thirty days of the date of announcing the order by the Tribunal, deposit the entire amount ordered in such manner as the Tribunal may direct.
article.html:
13Deposit of maintenance amount.

Section 13 · Chapter II · page 6 of the Act

When an order is made under this Chapter, the children or relative who is required to pay any amount in terms of such order shall within thirty days of the date of announcing the order by the Tribunal, deposit the entire amount ordered in such manner as the Tribunal may direct.
